audience: delivery dispatchers who plan and send driver routes in Spoke Dispatch

useCases.title: Review a day's plans and routes
useCases.text: The AI lists plans with date, depot and drivers and opens one. It reads the routes with driver, stop count and whether they were distributed, started or completed.

useCases.title: Find stops that failed or were not attempted
useCases.text: The AI searches stops by keyword or filter, for example attempted = false in one country, and opens a stop to read the delivery outcome, notes and photo links.

useCases.title: See the stops that are not on a plan yet
useCases.text: The AI lists imported stops that are on no plan, with their addresses, so you know what still has to be planned.

useCases.title: List the drivers and depots
useCases.text: The AI lists drivers with active flag and depots, and depots with addresses, working hours and maximum stops.

useCases.title: Create a plan and add its stops
useCases.text: The AI creates a plan for a date with a depot and drivers, then adds stops one by one or up to 100 at once. Nothing is sent to drivers.

useCases.title: Optimize a plan and send it to drivers
useCases.text: The AI starts the optimization, checks until it is done, and after your clear go-ahead sends each driver their route on their phone. Sending cannot be undone.
